name: water-ramp-on
description: plateau.w3x (level 3 on 2, make-plateau.mjs): a Ramp, size 3, at 750,630 (column 32 down the south face, ramp-plateau-row), then Shallow Water size 1 on it at the same spot: does the editor take the ramp flags the water breaks off, as its cliff brush does (test.md)? The editor takes the ramp's flags off (corners 32,25..27 ramp 0) and leaves row 25 at level 2, as Studio since branch water-brush-we2 (2026-11-14: dropBrokenRamps, waterBasin's foreignCliffNear). KNOWN DIFFERENCE (2026-11-14, two runs): the editor leaves corners 30..34,25 below the raised ones untyped (cliffType 15; Studio 1), as without the ramp (water-plateau-on)

name: water-ramp-below
description: the same ramp, then Shallow Water size 3 on the low ground in front of it (750,700), the brush reaching the ramp's lower corners: the editor takes the ramp's flags off, writes the water word 8448 (the ramp's middle corner half a level up) on the water and the dry corners round it and leaves the plateau's corners in the square on level 3 (2026-11-14, two runs); Studio the same since branch water-brush-we2 (tools.ts layerTarget's rampLift; before, it kept the flags, wrote 8192 and lowered the plateau's rim to 2)

name: water-ramp-deep
description: the same ramp, then Deep Water size 3 on it (750,630): the editor takes the ramp's flags off, raises only the low corners next to the water (rows 23..24 stay on level 2) and types the rim of the new cliff (2026-11-14, two runs); Studio the same since branch water-brush-we2 (before, it kept the flags on 32,25..27 and raised the whole square to 3)

name: water-plateau-on
description: the control of water-ramp-on without the ramp: Shallow Water size 1 at 750,630 on plateau.w3x's south face (corner 32,27). The editor raises only the three low corners next to the water to level 3 (35 world units up) and leaves the rest of the square on level 2: plateau.w3x's cliff is Grass Cliff, the chosen type (on slope-edge.w3x's Dirt Cliff it moves the whole square: waterrim.ts foreignCliffNear). KNOWN DIFFERENCE (2026-11-14, branch water-brush-we2): the editor leaves corners 30..34,25 below the raised ones untyped (15; Studio 1)

name: water-plateau-below
description: the control of water-ramp-below without the ramp: Shallow Water size 3 at 750,700 below the face (corner 32,26): the plateau's corners in the square stay on level 3 (2026-11-14, branch water-brush-we2)

name: water-plateau-deep
description: the control of water-ramp-deep without the ramp: Deep Water size 3 at 750,630 (corner 32,27): only the low corners next to the water come up (2026-11-14, branch water-brush-we2)
